label: normal
js: game.hold(1,false); game.start({who:'teddy', level:'normal', seed: 11}); game.step(3.4); game.autopilot(); var r3 = game.step(30); JSON.stringify([r3.x, r3.flyers.map(f=>[f.id,f.coins,f.hearts,f.out])])

label: podium
js: for (var i = 0; i < 400 && game.info().mode === 'fly'; i++) game.step(0.5); game.step(4.2); game.info().mode

label: zapped
js: game.start({who:'teddy', level:'normal', seed: 12}); game.step(3.4); var rc = game.race, f = rc.flyers[0]; for (var i = 0; i < 9000 && game.info().mode === 'fly'; i++) { var z = rc.lab.zaps.find(q => !q.spin && q.xb > rc.x - 0.3 && q.xa < rc.x + 0.3); if (z && f.safe <= 0) { f.y = (z.y1 + z.y2) / 2; f.vy = 0; } game.step(1/60); } game.step(1); game.info().mode
